verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial infrastructure API platform, so background automation is a fair axis. The only on-topic evidence is a marketing line about 'flows to automate lending and repayments' and a Webhook Events docs page, which enables event-driven integrations that customers build themselves. Neither documents user-configurable autonomous automations. Missing for 10: documented automation or scheduling features (e.g., recurring or scheduled payments, rule-based triggers), any detail on how automations are set up and run unattended, AI-native or agent-driven automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
